时用的是你自己配置的密钥。</p></div><ul class="lp-stack" data-v-4ba389d2=""><!--[--><li class="lp-stack__item" data-v-4ba389d2=""><h3 class="lp-col__title" data-v-4ba389d2="">本机存储</h3><p class="lp-col__desc" class="lp-col__desc" data-v-4ba389d2="">AGPL-3.0 许可，与隐私相关的实现都在源码里，可自行核对。</p></li><!--]--></ul></div></div></section><section id="voices" class="lp-block" data-v-4ba389d2=""><div class="lp-wrap   function t(key, params) {

  function isDark() {

  /* Vue 的 scoped CSS 是 [data-v-xxxx] 属性选择器：运行时新建的节点必须把同样的
     属性盖上，否则整块样式都吃不到（第一版把属性名当 class 拼了，结果面板背景透明）。
     从页面里已有的同类元素上抄属性名，再连同子树一起盖章 —— 与 Vue 的行为一致。 */
  function vAttrs(selector) {
    var el = document.querySelector(selector)
    if (!el) return []
    return Array.prototype.filter
      .call(el.attributes, function (a) {
        return a.name.indexOf('data-v-') === 0
      })
      .map(function (a) {
        return a.name
      })
  }
  var V_SITE = vAttrs('.SNav__pill')
  var V_LANG = vAttrs('.LangSelect')

  function stamp(el, attrs) {
    if (!el || !attrs || !attrs.length) return el
    attrs.forEach(function (name) {
      el.setAttribute(name, '')
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('*'), function (node) {
        node.setAttribute(name, '')
      })
    })
    return el
  }

  /* 文本节点必须在任何 DOM 增删之前快照：语言切换靠「第 N 个文本节点」定位，
     中途插入节点会错位。运行时新建节点里的文案单独同步（见 syncMirrors）。 */
  var TEXT_NODES = (function () {
    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false)
    var list = []
    var node
    while ((node = walker.nextNode())) list.push(node)
    return list
  })()

  /* ══ 主题 ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function paintThemeButtons() {
    var html = isDark() ? SUN_SVG : MOON_SVG
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-ds-theme]'), function (btn) {
      btn.innerHTML = html
    })
  }

  function setTheme(dark, persist) {
    root.classList.toggle('dark', dark)
    if (persist) {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(APPEARANCE_KEY, dark ? 'dark' : 'light')
      } catch (err) {
        /* 隐私模式：忽略 */
      }
    }
    paintThemeButtons()
    if (starfield) starfield.repaint()
    syncDemoFrame()
  }

  /* 「下一帧」工具：入场/展开动画都要求先渲染一帧再加类，否则过渡不生效。
     但 rAF 在页面不可见时（后台标签页、无头浏览器）根本不回调 —— 只挂 rAF 会让
     内容永远停在 opacity: 0。所以补一个 setTimeout 兜底，两边都是幂等操作。 */
  function nextFrame(fn) {
    var done = false
    var run = function () {
      if (done) return
      done = true
      fn()
    }
    if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') requestAnimationFrame(run)
    setTimeout(run, 60)
  }

  /* ══ Hero 交错入场 ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function showHero() {
    var el = document.querySelector('.t-stagger')
    if (!el) return
    nextFrame(function () {
      el.classList.add('is-shown')
    })
  }

  /* ══ 星空底图（Bayer 8×8 有序抖动出的 1-bit 网点星空，算法同 HeroStarfield.vue） ══ */
  var starfield = (function () {
    var host = document.querySelector('.sf')
    var canvas = host && host.querySelector('.sf__canvas')
    if (!host || !canvas) return null

    var SCALE = 0.5
    var MAX_OFF_W = 960
    var STAR_PER_PX = 1 / 5200
    var MIN_STARS = 90
    var MAX_STARS = 460
    var FPS = 30
    var Y_START = -18
    var Y_END = 118
    var CENTER_AT = 0.5
    var INK_DARK = [245, 245, 247]
    var INK_LIGHT = [29, 29, 31]
    var INK_ALPHA_DARK = 0.92
    var INK_ALPHA_LIGHT = 0.6

    var BAYER8 = new Uint8Array([
      0, 32, 8, 40, 2, 34, 10, 42, 48, 16, 56, 24, 50, 18, 58, 26, 12, 44, 4, 36, 14, 46, 6, 38,
      60, 28, 52, 20, 62, 30, 54, 22, 3, 35, 11, 43, 1, 33, 9, 41, 51, 19, 59, 27, 49, 17, 57, 25,
      15, 47, 7, 39, 13, 45, 5, 37, 63, 31, 55, 23, 61, 29, 53, 21
    ])
    var BAYER_THR = new Float32Array(64)
    for (var b = 0; b < 64; b += 1) BAYER_THR[b] = (BAYER8[b] + 0.5) / 64

    var ctx = null
    var imageData = null
    var intensity = null
    var mask = null
    var stars = []
    var ow = 0
    var oh = 0
    var loopId = 0
    var lastFrame = 0
    var scrollId = 0
    var scrollPending = false
    var resizeTimer = 0
    var running = false
    var inView = true
    var reduced = !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)

    function smoothstep(a, bx, x) {
      var p = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - a) / (bx - a)))
      return p * p * (3 - 2 * p)
    }

    function makeStars(w, h, cssW, cssH) {
      var count = Math.round(Math.min(MAX_STARS, Math.max(MIN_STARS, cssW * cssH * STAR_PER_PX)))
      var list = []
      for (var n = 0; n < count; n += 1) {
        var bright = Math.random() < 0.12
        list.push({
          x: Math.random() * w,
          y: Math.random() * h,
          r: bright ? 2.6 + Math.random() * 2.2 : 0.9 + Math.random() * 0.9,
          gain: bright ? 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.5 : 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.5,
          base: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.65,
          phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
          speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.6
        })
      }
      return list
    }

    /* 密度掩膜：四周软收边，中心再压一档，免得网点和大标题互相干扰 */
    function buildMask(w, h) {
      var m = new Float32Array(w * h)
      for (var y = 0; y < h; y += 1) {
        var v = (y + 0.5) / h
        var vFade = smoothstep(0, 0.12, v) * smoothstep(0, 0.16, 1 - v)
        var dv = (v - 0.52) / 0.34
        for (var x = 0; x < w; x += 1) {
          var u = (x + 0.5) / w
          var du = (u - 0.5) / 0.46
          var dip = 1 - 0.38 * Math.exp(-(du * du + dv * dv))
          m[y * w + x] = vFade * smoothstep(0, 0.06, u) * smoothstep(0, 0.06, 1 - u) * dip
        }
      }
      return m
    }

    /* RGB 只在主题变化时写一次，之后每帧只改 alpha */
    function paintInk() {
      if (!imageData) return
      var ink = isDark() ? INK_DARK : INK_LIGHT
      var data = imageData.data
      for (var p = 0; p < data.length; p += 4) {
        data[p] = ink[0]
        data[p + 1] = ink[1]
        data[p + 2] = ink[2]
      }
    }

    function renderFrame(ts) {
      if (!ctx || !imageData) return
      var tSec = ts / 1000
      intensity.fill(0)

      for (var s = 0; s < stars.length; s += 1) {
        var st = stars[s]
        var wave = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(tSec * st.speed + st.phase)
        var amp = st.gain * st.base * (0.4 + 0.6 * wave)
        var r2 = st.r * st.r
        var x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(st.x - st.r))
        var x1 = Math.min(ow - 1, Math.ceil(st.x + st.r))
        var y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(st.y - st.r))
        var y1 = Math.min(oh - 1, Math.ceil(st.y + st.r))
        for (var y = y0; y <= y1; y += 1) {
          var dy = y + 0.5 - st.y
          var dy2 = dy * dy
          var row = y * ow
          for (var x = x0; x <= x1; x += 1) {
            var dx = x + 0.5 - st.x
            var d2 = dx * dx + dy2
            if (d2 >= r2) continue
            var f = 1 - d2 / r2
            intensity[row + x] += amp * f * f
          }
        }
      }

      var data = imageData.data
      var alpha = Math.round(255 * (isDark() ? INK_ALPHA_DARK : INK_ALPHA_LIGHT))
      var idx = 0
      for (var yy = 0; yy < oh; yy += 1) {
        var by = (yy & 7) << 3
        for (var xx = 0; xx < ow; xx += 1, idx += 1) {
          var val = intensity[idx] * mask[idx]
          data[(idx << 2) + 3] = val > BAYER_THR[by | (xx & 7)] ? alpha : 0
        }
      }
      ctx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0)
    }

    function startLoop() {
      if (running || reduced) return
      running = true
      lastFrame = 0
      function tick(ts) {
        loopId = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
        if (ts - lastFrame < 1000 / FPS - 1) return
        lastFrame = ts
        renderFrame(ts)
      }
      loopId = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
    }

    function stopLoop() {
      running = false
      if (loopId) cancelAnimationFrame(loopId)
      loopId = 0
    }

    /* 闪烁只在「页面可见 + 星空在视口内」时跑，滑出画面就停掉 */
    function syncLoop() {
      if (reduced || document.hidden || !inView) stopLoop()
      else startLoop()
    }

    function updateProgress() {
      if (reduced) {
        host.style.setProperty('--sf-y', '0vh')
        host.style.setProperty('--sf-dim', '0')
        return
      }
      var anchor = document.querySelector('.lp-hero')
      var p
      if (anchor) {
        var rect = anchor.getBoundingClientRect()
        var total = Math.max(1, anchor.offsetHeight || rect.height)
        p = -rect.top / total
      } else {
        p = window.scrollY / (window.innerHeight || 1)
      }
      p = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, p))
      var y = p <= CENTER_AT ? Y_START * (1 - p / CENTER_AT) : (Y_END * (p - CENTER_AT)) / (1 - CENTER_AT)
      var dim = p <= CENTER_AT ? 0 : (p - CENTER_AT) / (1 - CENTER_AT)
      host.style.setProperty('--sf-y', y.toFixed(2) + 'vh')
      host.style.setProperty('--sf-dim', dim.toFixed(4))
    }

    function onScroll() {
      if (scrollPending) return
      scrollPending = true
      scrollId = requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        scrollPending = false
        updateProgress()
      })
    }

    function build() {
      var cssW = host.clientWidth
      var cssH = host.clientHeight
      if (!cssW || !cssH) return
      var scale = Math.min(SCALE, MAX_OFF_W / cssW)
      ow = Math.max(1, Math.round(cssW * scale))
      oh = Math.max(1, Math.round(cssH * scale))
      canvas.width = ow
      canvas.height = oh
      ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: true })
      if (!ctx) return
      ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false
      imageData = ctx.createImageData(ow, oh)
      intensity = new Float32Array(ow * oh)
      mask = buildMask(ow, oh)
      stars = makeStars(ow, oh, cssW, cssH)
      paintInk()
      renderFrame(0)
      host.classList.add('is-ready')
    }

    function onResize() {
      if (resizeTimer) clearTimeout(resizeTimer)
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () {
        build()
        updateProgress()
      }, 150)
    }

    if (reduced) host.classList.add('is-static')
    build()
    updateProgress()
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    window.addEventListener('resize', onResize)
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', syncLoop)
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver !== 'undefined') {
      new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        inView = entries[0] ? entries[0].isIntersecting : true
        syncLoop()
      }).observe(host)
    }
    syncLoop()

    return {
      repaint: function () {
        paintInk()
        if (!running) renderFrame(0)
      }
    }
  })()

  /* ══ GitHub Star 数（带会话缓存，避免触发限流） ═════════════════════════ */
  var starLink = document.querySelector('.lp-hero__gh')

  function formatStars(value) {
    if (value < 1000) return String(value)
    var k = value / 1000
    return (k >= 10 ? Math.round(k) : Math.round(k * 10) / 10) + 'k'
  }

  function setStarsLabel(count) {
    if (!starLink) return
    var text = count == null ? t('starsIdle') : t('stars', { n: formatStars(count) })
    var label = starLink.querySelector('span:not(.lp-hero__gh-arrow)')
    if (label) label.textContent = text
    starLink.setAttribute('aria-label', text)
  }

  function fetchStars() {
    var cached = null
    try {
      var raw = sessionStorage.getItem(STARS_CACHE_KEY)
      if (raw) {
        var parsed = JSON.parse(raw)
        if (typeof parsed.count === 'number' && Date.now() - parsed.at <= STARS_CACHE_TTL) {
          cached = parsed.count
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      cached = null
    }
    if (cached != null) {
      starsCount = cached
      setStarsLabel(cached)
      return
    }
    fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/' + GITHUB_REPO, {
      headers: { Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json' }
    })
      .then(function (res) {
        return res.ok ? res.json() : null
      })
      .then(function (data) {
        if (!data || typeof data.stargazers_count !== 'number') return
        starsCount = data.stargazers_count
        setStarsLabel(starsCount)
        try {
          sessionStorage.setItem(
            STARS_CACHE_KEY,
            JSON.stringify({ count: starsCount, at: Date.now() })
          )
        } catch (err) {
          /* 隐私模式：忽略 */
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        /* 离线 / 限流：保持原文案 */
      })
  }

  /* ══ 功能 tabs（pill 滑动 + 面板换内容） ═══════════════════════════════ */
  var tabsBar = document.querySelector('.t-tabs')
  var tabsPill = document.querySelector('.t-tabs-pill')
  var panelEl = document.querySelector('.t-panel-slide')
  var shots = panelEl ? panelEl.querySelectorAll('.lp-shot') : []
  var activeScene = 0
  var displayedScene = 0
  var closeTimer = null

  function sceneData(index) {
    var list = SCENES[lang] || SCENES['zh-CN']
    return list[index] || list[0]
  }

  function movePill(animate) {
    if (!tabsBar || !tabsPill) return
    var tabs = tabsBar.querySelectorAll('.t-tab')
    var selected = null
    for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i += 1) {
      if (tabs[i].getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true') selected = tabs[i]
    }
    if (!selected) selected = tabs[0]
    if (!selected) return
    if (!animate) {
      var prev = tabsPill.style.transition
      tabsPill.style.transition = 'none'
      tabsPill.style.transform = 'translateX(' + selected.offsetLeft + 'px)'
      tabsPill.style.width = selected.offsetWidth + 'px'
      void tabsPill.offsetWidth
      tabsPill.style.transition = prev
    } else {
      tabsPill.style.transform = 'translateX(' + selected.offsetLeft + 'px)'
      tabsPill.style.width = selected.offsetWidth + 'px'
    }
  }

  function renderScene(index) {
    if (!panelEl) return
    var scene = sceneData(index)
    var statement = panelEl.querySelector('.lp-statement')
    var descs = panelEl.querySelectorAll('.lp-col__desc')
    var link = panelEl.querySelector('.lp-textlink')
    if (statement) statement.textContent = scene.title
    if (descs[0]) descs[0].textContent = scene.lead
    if (descs[1]) descs[1].textContent = scene.desc
    if (link) {
      link.setAttribute('href', scene.link)
      link.innerHTML = t('more') + '<span aria-hidden="true"> ›</span>'
    }
    /* 四张截图一起内嵌在页面里（数据不重复进 JS），切换时只换显隐 */
    for (var i = 0; i < shots.length; i += 1) {
      var item = SCENES[lang] ? SCENES[lang][i] : null
      shots[i].hidden = i !== index
      if (item) shots[i].setAttribute('alt', item.alt)
    }
  }

  function selectScene(index) {
    if (index === activeScene || !panelEl) return
    activeScene = index
    var tabs = tabsBar ? tabsBar.querySelectorAll('.t-tab') : []
    for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i += 1) {
      tabs[i].setAttribute('aria-selected', i === index ? 'true' : 'false')
    }
    movePill(true)
    panelEl.setAttribute('data-open', 'false')
    var raw = getComputedStyle(panelEl).getPropertyValue('--panel-close-dur').trim()
    var dur = !raw ? 350 : raw.indexOf('ms') > -1 ? parseFloat(raw) : parseFloat(raw) * 1000
    if (closeTimer) clearTimeout(closeTimer)
    closeTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      displayedScene = index
      renderScene(index)
      panelEl.setAttribute('data-open', 'true')
    }, dur)
  }

  if (tabsBar) {
    tabsBar.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      var tab = event.target.closest ? event.target.closest('.t-tab') : null
      if (!tab) return
      var tabs = Array.prototype.slice.call(tabsBar.querySelectorAll('.t-tab'))
      selectScene(tabs.indexOf(tab))
    })
  }

  /* ══ FAQ 折叠 ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  var faqRoot = document.querySelector('.lp-faq')
  if (faqRoot) {
    faqRoot.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      var btn = event.target.closest ? event.target.closest('.lp-faq__btn') : null
      if (!btn) return
      var item = btn.closest('.lp-faq__item')
      var wasOpen = item.getAttribute('data-open') === 'true'
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(faqRoot.querySelectorAll('.lp-faq__item'), function (el) {
        el.setAttribute('data-open', 'false')
        var other = el.querySelector('.lp-faq__btn')
        if (other) other.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false')
      })
      if (!wasOpen) {
        item.setAttribute('data-open', 'true')
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true')
      }
    })
  }

  /* ══ 顶栏：指针跟随的镜面光斑（--sn-spec-x/y 由 @property 注册过才能插值） ══ */
  var barEl = document.querySelector('.SNav__bar')
  if (barEl && window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches) {
    var specRaf = 0
    var specX = 14
    var specY = -46
    barEl.addEventListener('pointermove', function (event) {
      var rect = barEl.getBoundingClientRect()
      if (!rect.width) return
      specX = -10 + ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 70
      specY = -60 + ((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 60
      if (specRaf) return
      specRaf = requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        specRaf = 0
        barEl.style.setProperty('--sn-spec-x', specX.toFixed(2) + '%')
        barEl.style.setProperty('--sn-spec-y', specY.toFixed(2) + '%')
      })
    })
  }

  /* ══ 语言切换（原站是路由跳转，这里把中英文本就地换掉） ═══════════════ */
  function applyTextMap(langKey) {
    for (var i = 0; i < TEXT_MAP.length; i += 1) {
      var entry = TEXT_MAP[i]
      var node = TEXT_NODES[entry[0]]
      if (node) node.nodeValue = langKey === 'en-US' ? entry[2] : entry[1]
    }
  }

  function setLang(next) {
    if (next === lang) return
    lang = next
    root.setAttribute('lang', next)
    applyTextMap(next)
    if (META[next]) {
      if (META[next].title) document.title = META[next].title
      var md = document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]')
      if (md && META[next].desc) md.setAttribute('content', META[next].desc)
    }
    renderScene(displayedScene)
    setStarsLabel(starsCount)
    syncMirrors()
    syncLangLabels()
    syncDemoFrame()
  }

  /* ══ 语言下拉（原站是自写组件 + Teleport 到 body，这里同样 fixed 自算坐标） ══ */
  var langMenu = null
  var langAnchor = null

  function positionLangMenu() {
    if (!langMenu || !langAnchor) return
    var r = langAnchor.getBoundingClientRect()
    var gap = 10
    var h = langMenu.offsetHeight || 80
    var w = langMenu.offsetWidth || 140
    var flipUp = r.bottom + gap + h > window.innerHeight - 8 && r.top - gap - h > 8
    langMenu.style.top = (flipUp ? r.top - gap - h : r.bottom + gap) + 'px'
    langMenu.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(r.left, window.innerWidth - w - 8)) + 'px'
  }

  function buildLangMenu() {
    langMenu = document.createElement('ul')
    langMenu.className = 'LangSelect__menu'
    langMenu.setAttribute('role', 'listbox')
    for (var i = 0; i < LANGS.length; i += 1) {
      var li = document.createElement('li')
      li.className = 'LangSelect__item'
      li.setAttribute('role', 'option')
      li.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1')
      li.setAttribute('data-ds-lang', LANGS[i].key)
      li.innerHTML =
        '<span class="LangSelect__item-label">' +
        LANGS[i].label +
        '</span><svg class="LangSelect__check" viewBox="0 0 14 14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.6 7.4 5.4 10.2 11.4 3.9"/></svg>'
      li.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var key = this.getAttribute('data-ds-lang')
        closeLangMenu()
        setLang(key)
      })
      langMenu.appendChild(li)
    }
    stamp(langMenu, V_LANG)
    document.body.appendChild(langMenu)
  }

  function openLangMenu(anchor) {
    if (!langMenu) buildLangMenu()
    langAnchor = anchor
    langMenu.setAttribute('aria-label', t('lang'))
    langMenu.style.display = 'block'
    langMenu.classList.remove('ds-in')
    positionLangMenu()
    nextFrame(function () {
      positionLangMenu()
      langMenu.classList.add('ds-in')
    })
    syncLangLabels()
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.LangSelect'), function (el) {
      el.classList.toggle('is-open', el.contains(anchor))
    })
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.LangSelect__button'), function (el) {
      el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', el === anchor ? 'true' : 'false')
    })
  }

  function closeLangMenu() {
    if (!langMenu) return
    langMenu.classList.remove('ds-in')
    langMenu.style.display = 'none'
    langAnchor = null
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.LangSelect'), function (el) {
      el.classList.remove('is-open')
    })
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.LangSelect__button'), function (el) {
      el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false')
    })
  }

  function syncLangLabels() {
    var label = lang === 'en-US' ? 'English' : '简体中文'
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.LangSelect__label'), function (el) {
      el.textContent = label
    })
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.LangSelect__button'), function (el) {
      el.setAttribute('aria-label', t('lang'))
    })
    if (langMenu) {
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(langMenu.querySelectorAll('.LangSelect__item'), function (el) {
        var key = el.getAttribute('data-ds-lang')
        el.classList.toggle('is-selected', key === lang)
        el.setAttribute('aria-selected', key === lang ? 'true' : 'false')
        el.querySelector('.LangSelect__check').style.display = key === lang ? '' : 'none'
      })
    }
  }

  /* ══ 移动端展开面板（SSR 里不存在，运行时按需构建） ════════════════════ */
  var backdropEl = null
  var sheetEl = null
  var burgerEl = document.querySelector('.SNav__burger')
  var SHEET_LINKS = ['/what-is-deepstudent', '/support']

  function buildSheet() {
    if (!burgerEl || sheetEl) return
    var header = burgerEl.closest('.SNav')

    backdropEl = document.createElement('div')
    backdropEl.className = 'SNav__backdrop'
    backdropEl.addEventListener('click', closeSheet)

    sheetEl = document.createElement('div')
    sheetEl.className = 'SNav__sheet'

    var nav = document.createElement('nav')
    nav.className = 'SNav__sheet-links'
    for (var i = 0; i < SHEET_LINKS.length; i += 1) {
      var a = document.createElement('a')
      a.className = 'SNav__sheet-link'
      a.setAttribute('href', SHEET_LINKS[i])
      a.setAttribute('data-ds-sheet-link', String(i))
      a.addEventListener('click', closeSheet)
      nav.appendChild(a)
    }
    sheetEl.appendChild(nav)

    var foot = document.createElement('div')
    foot.className = 'SNav__sheet-foot'

    var langRoot = document.createElement('span')
    langRoot.className = 'LangSelect'
    langRoot.innerHTML =
      '<button class="LangSelect__button" type="button" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false">' +
      '<span class="LangSelect__label"></span>' +
      '<svg class="LangSelect__caret" viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.75 4.5 6 7.75l3.25-3.25"/></svg></button>'
    foot.appendChild(langRoot)

    var themeBtn = document.createElement('button')
    themeBtn.className = 'SNav__icon'
    themeBtn.type = 'button'
    themeBtn.setAttribute('data-ds-theme', '')
    themeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      setTheme(!isDark(), true)
    })
    foot.appendChild(themeBtn)

    var cta = document.createElement('a')
    cta.className = 'SNav__cta'
    cta.setAttribute('href', '/download')
    cta.setAttribute('data-ds-sheet-cta', '')
    cta.addEventListener('click', closeSheet)
    foot.appendChild(cta)

    sheetEl.appendChild(foot)
    header.appendChild(backdropEl)
    header.appendChild(sheetEl)
    /* 盖 scope 属性：整块面板用 SiteNav 的；里面的语言开关是子组件，另有一套 */
    stamp(backdropEl, V_SITE)
    stamp(sheetEl, V_SITE)
    stamp(langRoot, V_LANG)
    paintThemeButtons()
    syncMirrors()
    syncLangLabels()
  }

  /* 运行时新建节点里的文案：从原节点抄一份，语言切换后重抄即可 */
  function syncMirrors() {
    if (!sheetEl) return
    var links = sheetEl.querySelectorAll('[data-ds-sheet-link]')
    var sourceLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.SNav__link')
    for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i += 1) {
      var src = sourceLinks[Number(links[i].getAttribute('data-ds-sheet-link'))]
      if (src) links[i].textContent = src.textContent
    }
    var cta = sheetEl.querySelector('[data-ds-sheet-cta]')
    var srcCta = document.querySelector('.SNav__cta')
    if (cta && srcCta) cta.textContent = srcCta.textContent
    var nav = sheetEl.querySelector('.SNav__sheet-links')
    if (nav) nav.setAttribute('aria-label', t('primary'))
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(sheetEl.querySelectorAll('[data-ds-theme]'), function (btn) {
      btn.setAttribute('aria-label', t('theme'))
    })
  }

  function openSheet() {
    buildSheet()
    if (!sheetEl) return
    burgerEl.classList.add('is-open')
    burgerEl.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true')
    root.classList.add('sn-menu-open')
    backdropEl.style.display = 'block'
    sheetEl.style.display = 'block'
    nextFrame(function () {
      backdropEl.classList.add('ds-in')
      sheetEl.classList.add('ds-in')
    })
  }

  function closeSheet() {
    if (!sheetEl) return
    var wasOpen = sheetEl.classList.contains('ds-in')
    backdropEl.classList.remove('ds-in')
    sheetEl.classList.remove('ds-in')
    if (burgerEl) {
      burgerEl.classList.remove('is-open')
      burgerEl.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false')
    }
    root.classList.remove('sn-menu-open')
    closeLangMenu()
    if (!wasOpen) return
    setTimeout(function () {
      if (!sheetEl.classList.contains('ds-in')) {
        backdropEl.style.display = 'none'
        sheetEl.style.display = 'none'
      }
    }, 300)
  }

  function toggleSheet() {
    if (sheetEl && sheetEl.classList.contains('ds-in')) closeSheet()
    else openSheet()
  }

  /* ══ 应用演示窗壳（在线演示嵌在 macOS 窗壳里，同源镜像在单文件里拿不到） ══ */
  var shellWindow = document.querySelector('.sh__window')
  var shellScreen = document.querySelector('.sh__screen')
  var demoFrame = document.querySelector('.sh__frame')
  var demoTimer = null
  var insecure = window.location.protocol === 'https:'

  function demoSrc() {
    return DEMO_URL + (isDark() ? (DEMO_URL.indexOf('?') > -1 ? '&' : '?') + 'theme=dark' : '')
  }

  function hideLoading() {
    if (demoTimer) clearTimeout(demoTimer)
    demoTimer = null
    var el = document.querySelector('.sh__loading')
    if (el) el.classList.add('is-done')
  }

  function syncDemoFrame() {
    if (!demoFrame || insecure) return
    var next = demoSrc()
    if (demoFrame.getAttribute('src') === next) return
    var loading = document.querySelector('.sh__loading')
    if (loading) loading.classList.remove('is-done')
    if (demoTimer) clearTimeout(demoTimer)
    demoTimer = setTimeout(hideLoading, 15000)
    demoFrame.setAttribute('src', next)
  }

  function fitShell() {
    if (!shellWindow || !shellScreen) return
    if (insecure || window.innerWidth < 768) {
      shellScreen.style.transform = ''
      return
    }
    shellScreen.style.transform = 'scale(' + shellWindow.clientWidth / NATIVE_W + ')'
  }

  function bootShell() {
    if (!document.querySelector('.sh')) return
    var loadText = document.querySelector('.sh__load-text')
    if (insecure) {
      if (loadText) loadText.textContent = t('insecure')
      var box = document.querySelector('.sh__loading')
      if (box) {
        box.style.padding = '0 28px'
        box.style.textAlign = 'center'
        box.style.lineHeight = '1.7'
      }
      return
    }
    if (loadText) loadText.textContent = t('loading')
    syncDemoFrame()
    if (demoFrame) {
      demoFrame.setAttribute('title', t('demoTitle'))
      demoFrame.addEventListener('load', function () {
        if (demoTimer) clearTimeout(demoTimer)
        demoTimer = setTimeout(hideLoading, 600)
      })
    }
    fitShell()
    window.addEventListener('resize', fitShell)
  }

  /* ══ 启动 ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    var target = event.target
    var btn = target.closest ? target.closest('.LangSelect__button') : null
    if (btn) {
      event.preventDefault()
      if (langAnchor === btn) closeLangMenu()
      else openLangMenu(btn)
      return
    }
    if (langMenu && langMenu.contains(target)) return
    if (langAnchor) closeLangMenu()
    if (target.closest && target.closest('.SNav__burger')) {
      toggleSheet()
      return
    }
    if (sheetEl && sheetEl.classList.contains('ds-in') && !sheetEl.contains(target)) closeSheet()
  })

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      closeLangMenu()
      closeSheet()
      return
    }
    if (!langAnchor || !langMenu) return
    var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(langMenu.querySelectorAll('.LangSelect__item'))
    var index = items.indexOf(document.activeElement)
    if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      event.preventDefault()
      items[(index + 1 + items.length) % items.length].focus()
    } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      event.preventDefault()
      items[(index - 1 + items.length) % items.length].focus()
    } else if ((event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') && index >= 0) {
      event.preventDefault()
      var key = items[index].getAttribute('data-ds-lang')
      closeLangMenu()
      setLang(key)
    }
  })

  showHero()
  movePill(false)
  paintThemeButtons()
  syncLangLabels()
  bootShell()
  fetchStars()
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    movePill(false)
    if (langAnchor) positionLangMenu()
  })
})()

</script>
</body></html>
